title: 90-Min Study With Me 🎧 Lofi Girl Rainy Night · 3 × 25/5 Pomodoro (Quiet Focus)
description:
Study beside a lofi girl at her desk on a rainy city night. 🎧 Music only during breaks — gentle rain keeps you company while you focus.

⏱️ FORMAT
• 3 sessions × (25 min focus / 5 min break) — classic Pomodoro
• 10-second countdown to begin
• Soft clock ticks in the last 10 seconds of every phase
• 🎵 Music ONLY during breaks — while you focus, just gentle night rain

🕖 TIMESTAMPS
00:00 — Intro & 10-second countdown
00:14 — Session 1 · Focus 25:00
25:14 — Break 5:00 (music)
30:14 — Session 2 · Focus 25:00
55:14 — Break 5:00 (music)
1:00:14 — Session 3 · Focus 25:00
1:25:14 — Break 5:00 (music)
1:30:14 — Well done 🎉

🎧 Best with headphones. Put your phone away and let's get things done.

🌱 Like & subscribe for more study-with-me timers and deep-focus sessions.
